computed.background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0) — transparent; darkening comes from the 3D creature/hero background itself, not an opaque panel fill

menu_link.hover_effect_note: large light-weight display serif/sans at 45px — clearly an editorial statement-typography menu, not a compact UI list

secondary_blocks.summary: 'Watch our Showreel' link with red chevron icon
large serif tagline 'We Make Good Shit' (brand statement, not navigational)
inline text-separated row: Facebook / Instagram / Dribbble / Twitter / Newsletter

computed.position: relative (sits in top-right of header bar)

close.note: explicit X glyph, top-right, swaps from the hamburger toggle button

motion.item_stagger: numbered list (01-05) suggests a staged/staggered reveal by index, not confirmed by computed style

mechanics.body_overflow: not checked (hero canvas kept running behind menu, suggesting scroll may not be hard-locked the same way)

notes: STRUCTURAL: true full-viewport (0/0/0/0 fixed) overlay drawer with oversized editorial typography (45px, weight 200) as the PRIMARY design signature — closer to an art-directed full-screen takeover than a compact list. Distinct third archetype vs lamalama's floating card and lusion's anchored dropdown-stack.
